carry_forward_classification.definition: Empirical/documentary relation to predecessor release for the same measure/geography/value type.
carry_forward_classification.missing_policy: Never missing; use ambiguous if evidence is insufficient/conflicting.
carry_forward_classification.source_rule: Use source-year documentation plus exact-copy diagnostics; exact requires 100%, revised requires same documented source wave and >=99.5% exact.

comparability_breaks.definition: Known break types that can invalidate naive cross-release comparison.
comparability_breaks.missing_policy: Empty list only after explicit check.
comparability_breaks.source_rule: CDC release notes/methodology/measure definitions are primary authority; unresolved conflicts remain explicitly coded.

brfss_source_year.definition: BRFSS year underlying the specific measure record, not nominal release year.
brfss_source_year.missing_policy: No guessed values; unresolved records must not enter the strict validated crosswalk.
brfss_source_year.source_rule: CDC release descriptions/release notes, verified against Year fields where present.

exact_copy_percentage.definition: Percent of common geographies whose point estimate and confidence interval are exactly equal to predecessor.
exact_copy_percentage.missing_policy: null until computed on archived compatible snapshots.
exact_copy_percentage.source_rule: Computed only from archived records under common-geography restriction.

definition_comparability.definition: Whether measure wording/eligibility/construct is materially comparable to predecessor.
definition_comparability.source_rule: CDC measure definitions and release notes.

geography_population_comparability.definition: Whether geography vintage, product coverage, and poststratification population basis support the intended comparison.
